outcome: Autosomal recessive Hereditary Spastic Paraplegias (AR HSPs)
cohort: The study investigated 10 patients diagnosed with Autosomal Recessive Hereditary Spastic Paraplegias (AR HSPs).
finding: The study identified pathogenic and novel variants in several genes (SPART, FA2H, AP4B1, SPG7, SPG11, CYP2U1, and CYP7B1) associated with AR HSPs, expanding the known genetic spectrum and highlighting the complexity of genotype-phenotype correlations.
